verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a TypeScript agent framework with a CLI and Studio, but the evidence pack never documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The self-hosted model gateways and the AUTO_BLOCK_EXTERNAL_PROVIDERS setting are adjacent privacy controls over model routing, not a way to disable vendor telemetry. The observability features describe tracing the user's own agents, not opting out of product usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
